title: Fluoride & Iron Contamination in Deep Borewells across 12 Hamlets
description: High incidence of dental fluorosis and gastrointestinal distress reported among 4,200 villagers due to excessive dissolved iron and fluoride levels (over 3.2 mg/L) in community handpumps. Conventional sand filters are clogging rapidly and local water committees lack simple testing and rejuvenation tools.

evidence.caption: Handpump showing red iron sludge precipitate at Banari village center
PHED District Water Testing Laboratory Report (Feb 2026)

universityProposal.title: Low-Cost Bio-Adsorbent Activated Red Mud & Clay Cartridge Filter for Rural Handpumps
universityProposal.abstract: Developing a gravity-fed, electricity-free modular filtration cylinder using local Jharkhand red clay enriched with activated carbon from agricultural waste. Reduces fluoride below 1.0 mg/L with zero chemical runoff and regenerable cartridges.
universityProposal.intellectualPropertyTarget: Indian Patent Application for Regenerable Bio-Ceramic Filter Media

industrySponsor.contactPerson: Siddharth Mukherjee (Head of Rural Water Initiatives)
industrySponsor.deliverablesExpected: Installation and water testing validation at 5 community borewells in Bishunpur.

title: Solar-Powered Automated Lac & Tussar Silk Processing for Tribal SHGs
description: Over 600 tribal women lac cultivators in Khunti struggle with manual scrape-processing of sticklac and boiling cocoons. Inefficient traditional tools cause high wastage (up to 38% yield loss) and respiratory ailments from open firewood smoke. There is urgent need for an affordable solar mechanical scraper and temperature-controlled defoliator.

evidence.caption: Manual hand scrapping of raw sticklac by women self-help group members

universityProposal.departmentLead: Faculty of Agricultural Engineering & Non-Timber Forest Products Lab
universityProposal.title: Ergonomic Solar Dual-Action Sticklac Cracker and Cocoon Reeling Machine
universityProposal.abstract: A compact, 180-watt portable solar machine with food-grade silicone rollers to crack sticklac without damaging seedlac granules, featuring digital temperature feedback for cocoon degumming.
universityProposal.intellectualPropertyTarget: Design Registration & Utility Patent with BAU Innovation Cell

industryMentorsAssigned: Sunil Kindo (Tribal Cooperative Supply Chain Advisor)
industrySponsor.deliverablesExpected: Field trial with 4 SHG clusters in Murhu; 30% increase in daily processed volume.
industrySponsor.deploymentSite: Burju Village Common Facility Centre, Khunti

title: AI Smart Dust Suppression & Micro-Climate Sensors for Coal Haul Roads
description: Heavy coal transportation trucks kicking up PM2.5 and PM10 particulate clouds exceeding 480 µg/m³ near residential habitations bordering open-cast mines. Current sprinkler trucks spray water intermittently without correlation to dust concentration or wind direction, causing severe water wastage and respiratory distress in adjacent school areas.
